references.text: Reuel is also called Jethro, Moses' father-in-law. Here in Numbers 10:29, Hobab, son of Reuel the Midianite, is referred to as Moses' father-in-law.
Jethro, the priest of Midian, is the same person as Reuel. Moses married his daughter Zipporah.
Jethro, the priest of Midian and Moses' father-in-law, is identified as Reuel in Exodus 2:18.
Reuel was also the name of a son of Esau and Bashemath, showing that the name was common among Semitic peoples.
A similar scene where Jacob meets Rachel at the well and helps water the sheep, parallel to Moses' meeting with Reuel's daughters.
